issues.name: Authentication bypass â€” forged JWT accepted on protected endpoint
issues.description: A JWT token signed with the hardcoded fallback secret ('jwt-secret-dev-fallback-2024') was accepted as valid on the GET /api/v1/users endpoint. The forged token specified role=ADMIN and an arbitrary userId. The server returned HTTP 200 with full user records. No valid session was established prior to the request.
issues.remediation: Remove the hardcoded fallback signing secret from source code. Require ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET to be set at startup. Rotate all existing tokens.

evidence.notes: JWT header: alg=HS256. Signed with 'jwt-secret-dev-fallback-2024'. Server accepted without rejection. Role claim not validated against database record.

issues.name: SQL injection
issues.description: SQL injection confirmed in the 'q' parameter of the product search endpoint via time-delay technique. No authentication required. A SLEEP-based payload caused a 5-second response delay confirming blind SQL injection.
issues.remediation: Use parameterized queries. Replace $queryRawUnsafe with prisma.$queryRaw tagged templates.

issues.name: Broken object level authorization â€” order history
issues.description: GET /api/v1/orders/:id returns order details without verifying the authenticated user owns the requested order. An authenticated user can retrieve any order by supplying an arbitrary orderId. Response includes billing address, items purchased, payment summary, and the order owner's user ID.
issues.remediation: Add ownership check: verify req.user.id matches the userId on the retrieved order before returning the response. Return 403 if the order belongs to a different user.

issues.name: User enumeration via response differential
issues.description: The POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password endpoint returns different HTTP status codes and response bodies for registered vs. unregistered email addresses, enabling enumeration of registered accounts without authentication.
issues.remediation: Return the same generic message and HTTP 200 status regardless of whether the email address is registered. Do not disclose account existence.

response.body_preview: {"message": "No account found with that email address"}

evidence.notes: Status code and body both differ â€” enumeration trivially confirmed without authentication

issues.name: SQL injection â€” GraphQL endpoint
issues.description: SQL injection confirmed in GraphQL productSearch resolver. Time-delay and extraction payloads successful. The endpoint accepted SQL metacharacter payloads without returning 403.
issues.remediation: Use parameterized queries in GraphQL resolvers.

request.body: {"query":"{ productSearch(query: \"shoes' AND 1=CAST((SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables LIMIT 1) AS INT)--\") { id name } }"}

issues.name: Server-side request forgery (SSRF)
issues.description: SSRF confirmed. Connection to 169.254.169.254 IMDS successful. Endpoint does not require authentication.
issues.remediation: Validate URL against allowlist. Block private IP ranges.

issues.name: File path traversal
issues.description: Path traversal confirmed. Authenticated request with file=../../etc/passwd returns contents of /etc/passwd.
issues.remediation: Validate path against base directory prefix after resolution.

issues.name: Stored cross-site scripting
issues.description: Stored XSS confirmed in the admin product dashboard. A product description containing '' was stored via the admin API and rendered without sanitization in the ProductSummary component (dangerouslySetInnerHTML). The payload executed when the product page was loaded in the admin dashboard.
issues.remediation: Sanitize HTML before rendering with dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Use DOMPurify or equivalent.

issues.name: Mass assignment
issues.description: Mass assignment confirmed at PUT /api/v1/users/settings. Request body containing {'role': 'ADMIN'} was accepted and the user's role was updated to ADMIN. The endpoint does not validate or restrict which fields may be modified via the request body.
issues.remediation: Allowlist permitted fields. Destructure only expected properties from req.body before passing to the database update.

issues.name: XML external entity injection
issues.description: XXE injection confirmed at the XML catalog import endpoint. A DOCTYPE declaration with an external entity reference pointing to file:///etc/passwd was accepted by the parser. The parsed document's node text content reflected the contents of the target file in the error response.
issues.remediation: Disable external entity resolution in the XML parser configuration. Upgrade xmldom to 0.7.0 or later.

issues.name: Client-side prototype pollution
issues.description: Prototype pollution confirmed via the PUT /api/v1/users/settings preferences field. A JSON body containing {'preferences': {'__proto__': {'polluted': 'yes'}}} was accepted. A follow-up request to an endpoint that constructs a new object and reads inherited properties confirmed the pollution: the inherited 'polluted' key was visible in the new object's context.
issues.remediation: Add hasOwnProperty guard in deepMerge. Freeze Object.prototype in application bootstrap. Sanitize incoming JSON before recursive merging.

issues.name: Broken object level authorization
issues.description: Unauthenticated PUT request to /api/v1/reviews/:id accepted and review modified. No session token required.
issues.remediation: Add protect middleware and author ownership check.

issues.name: Race condition on coupon redemption (persists from prior scan)
issues.description: Race condition on single-use coupon redemption â€” first identified in 2026-07-02 scan. Concurrent requests bypass the single-use restriction. Retest confirms vulnerability persists in this build.
issues.remediation: Use SELECT FOR UPDATE or atomic compare-and-swap for coupon redemption.

response.body_preview: 5 of 8 returned HTTP 200 with coupon applied. Expected: 1 of 8.

issues.name: Broken object level authorization â€” order history (persists)
issues.description: IDOR on GET /api/v1/orders/:id persists from prior scans (2026-06-20, 2026-07-02). No remediation applied. Authenticated user can still retrieve orders belonging to other users.
issues.remediation: Add ownership check before returning order data.

issues.name: User enumeration via response differential (persists)
issues.description: Response differential on /api/v1/auth/forgot-password persists from prior scans. No remediation applied.
issues.remediation: Return identical response regardless of account existence.

response.body_preview: {"message": "No account found with that email address"}
